steps: Define the source statement as LB_N(1+epsilon): every nonuniform Boolean circuit for H_N^SAT has size greater than N^{1+epsilon-o(1)}.
Define Psys_bEF lines over bit encodings of G_N(x,j), EF extension variables, explicit SATeq links, and bounded-SR_h invocations; reject any line whose row or formula dependency is only symbolic.

Topologically traverse the EF extension-DAG. For each extension variable v, add its declared dependency circuit/list to S_dep(pi), mark it as charged, and recursively add predecessor dependencies once.
For each SATeq line, record both explicit formula encodings and add the bit-comparison or semantic-link charge to S_link(pi); this prevents equality reasoning from becoming hidden advice.

For each bounded-SR_h invocation on a supported row, unfold at most N^{eta+o(1)} leaves and attach a leaf solver or verifier of cost N^{tau+o(1)}; over M_N=N^{q+o(1)} slots this gives N^{q+eta+tau+o(1)}.
Let E_N be the residual number of rows on which the parsed transcript does not certify the required parity behavior. Patch those rows by equality tests at cost E_N N.
Compose the generator circuit of size N^{rho+o(1)} with the parsed transcript and patch circuits. The resulting nonuniform circuit has size at most N^{rho+o(1)}+Gamma_bEF(pi).
Conclude the falsifier theorem: if this upper bound is below N^{1+epsilon-o(1)}, the asserted source lower bound LB_N(1+epsilon) is false in the same circuit model.

For Psys_sym, test a FormulaEval-SAT line. If it is row-expanded, charge N*M_N=N^{1+q+o(1)} occurrences; if it is left symbolic, construct a private-row assignment that agrees on all surface occurrences but flips an unexpanded row, showing surface occurrence completion is unsound.

steps: Define Psys_bEF^- lines at bit level: EF extension definitions are acyclic references to earlier formulas; SATeq lines carry explicit quotient witnesses; bounded-SR_h rules carry addresses of at most h=N^{tau+o(1)} touched occurrence neighborhoods.

Run a line induction. For an extension line, add its referenced formula bits to S_dep(pi). For a witnessed SATeq line, contract the equality quotient and charge S_link(pi) plus decoder overhead eta. For a bounded-SR_h line, copy only the listed local neighborhoods, giving the N^{q+eta+tau+o(1)} support term across M_N=N^{q+o(1)} query layers.

Maintain invariant I_l: after parsing line l, every row parity claimed forced by the prefix is either represented in Q_pi by explicit generated SAT occurrences or is listed among E_N exceptional rows.

At the final LB_N line, compose the advice-free generator circuit of size N^{rho+o(1)} with the parsed transcript. Hardwire the finite transcript and patch the E_N exceptional rows by equality tests, yielding C(H_N^SAT)<=N^{rho+o(1)}+Gamma_bEF(pi).
Compare this upper bound with the target lower bound N^{1+epsilon-o(1)}. If it is smaller, the packet is a falsifier for LB_N or for the soundness of such a low-cost proof in the stated model.
